results.message: Who won the Booker Prize in each of the last three years, and which of those three books is the shortest?
results.answer:
The Booker Prize winners were:

- **2023 — *Prophet Song* by Paul Lynch.** Oneworld; **320 pages**. ([thebookerprizes.com](https://thebookerprizes.com/the-booker-library/prize-years/2023))
- **2024 — *Orbital* by Samantha Harvey.** Jonathan Cape; **144 pages**. ([thebookerprizes.com](https://thebookerprizes.com/the-booker-library/prize-years/2024))
- **2025 — *Flesh* by David Szalay.** Jonathan Cape; **349 pages** in the UK edition. ([thebookerprizes.com](https://thebookerprizes.com/the-booker-library/prize-years/2025))

Page counts can differ by edition.

David Szalay won the 2025 Booker Prize for *Flesh*. Previous winners were Samantha Harvey for *Orbital* (2024) and Paul Lynch for *Prophet Song* (2023). ([thebookerprizes.com](https://thebookerprizes.com/media-centre/press-releases/flesh-by-david-szalay-wins-the-booker-prize-2025))
